item.title: Lions suffer home defeat to Portsmouth
item.description: Millwall were beaten 3-1 at home by Portsmouth in the Sky Bet Championship on Saturday afternoon. After a goalless first-half, Pompey were in front inside 20 seconds of the restart as Gustavo Caballero scored, with John Swift doubling their lead minutes later. Casper De Norre pulled one back for The Lions, but Marlon Pack's attempt then saw the visitors score a third and seal a first loss in SE16 since December.
